sources.title: ACT (Action Chunking with Transformers) · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ACT (Action Chunking with Transformers) ACT is a lightweight and efficient policy for imitation learning, especially well-suited for fine-grained manipulation tasks. It's the first model we recommend when you're starting out with LeRobot due to its fast training time, low computational requirements, and strong performance.
